{{Top}}
[[File:NoDivision-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''No Division'', an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda piece, was one of the many paintings available in the galaxy.]]
'''Paintings''' and '''posters''' were works of art that could be hung and displayed on a wall. Many paintings existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including ''[[Intense Performer]]'', ''[[Alderaan Refugees]]'' and ''[[No Division]]''. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] hired a painter to paint portraits showing the gloriousness of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] for propaganda purposes.

Paintings were generally transported in specialized containers. [[Multi-painting]]s were a type of painting.
